description: This file contains functions for language translation prompts, including language labeling, prompt construction, and glossary handling for internationalization features.

methods.name: prettyLanguageLabel
methods.description: Converts language codes into human-readable language labels.

methods.name: translationPrompt
methods.description: Generates translation prompts based on source and target languages, selecting templates accordingly.

methods.name: buildGlossaryPrompt
methods.description: Builds a glossary section for prompts from a list of glossary entries.
